## Founder

**Phillip Krzankowski** is an SEO expert and the founder of Findable. He built SEO and AI visibility for his own business (deltaseven.io, a math tutoring service) out of necessity — without any SEO agency, SEO company, Google Pay-Per-Click advertising, or paid services. Using only search engine optimization and AI visibility strategies, the result was enormous organic growth, including 16 new clients from organic Google search and 5 referrals from ChatGPT within 90 days. He now applies the same proven SEO marketing strategies to other small businesses as an independent SEO consultant.

## Services Offered

### Google Visibility (Local SEO Services / Search Engine Optimization)
Affordable SEO services to help small businesses rank higher in Google Search, Google Maps, and "near me" results. Our local SEO services include on-page SEO optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, local search signals, review management, and technical SEO improvements that drive organic traffic and improve your Google ranking. We help you show up on Google and get found by customers searching for your services.

### AI Visibility (AI SEO / Generative Engine Optimization / Answer Engine Optimization)
People don't just Google things anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Siri, and other AI assistants. Through AI SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) — also known as answer engine optimization (AEO) — we optimize your business's online presence so that AI systems accurately recommend and reference your business when users ask relevant questions. This is a new and rapidly growing channel for customer acquisition.

### Free SEO Consultation
We offer a free 15-minute SEO consultation for an honest look at your current Google ranking, online marketing presence, and AI visibility — and what opportunities exist for organic growth.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How long does it take to see results from local SEO?**
Most clients are live in 1–2 weeks. After a single round of optimizations, clients typically see measurable results within 90 days — including new clients from Google and referrals from AI assistants like ChatGPT.

**Do you require long-term contracts?**
No. Findable operates month-to-month. No long-term contracts or lock-ins. After launch, we monitor your rankings and keep everything optimized for as long as you'd like.

**Can my business really show up in ChatGPT and AI assistants?**
Yes. People don't just Google things anymore — they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Siri. We optimize your business to appear in both traditional search results and AI-generated responses. One of our clients received 5 referrals from ChatGPT within 90 days.

**How much does it cost?**
Every business is different. We offer a free 15-minute consultation to assess where you stand and recommend next steps. No pitch, no pressure. Call or text 224-343-8086 or email phil@deltaseven.io.

**What makes Findable different from an agency?**
Findable is an independent contractor. It's one person — Phil — who built these strategies for his own business first, proved they work, and now applies them to other small businesses. Every strategy used on your website is one that's been tested and validated on his own business first.
